title: A Methodology for Studying Linguistic and Cultural Change in China, 1900-1950
reasoning: The paper focuses on computational humanities and conceptual history by using word counts and temporal word embeddings to analyze linguistic changes in 20th-century Chinese texts. While it tracks the frequency of words like 'religion' (宗教) and 'Christianity' (基督教) as part of its historical analysis, it does not evaluate, benchmark, or specifically study religion, faith, or ethics as a subject of investigation.
